long_biography.plain_text:
Keeping experienced staff during a shutdown helped energy entrepreneur Rashid Sardarov restart a gas-processing installation in Orenburg. His company maintained the idle equipment and retained skilled workers, enabling production to resume in less than a month. The installation removed impurities from raw gas, including supplies from Kazakhstan, to produce gas suitable for pipelines.

In Namibia, he founded and fully funded Victoria Beacon Private School for workers' children and other selected vulnerable pupils. His support covers boarding, meals, uniforms and daily care as well as tuition. The school also provides full university scholarships at Russia's RUDN University for exceptional learners.
